phase: Environment advisories and real starter contract
implemented: Real starter package.json scripts and file tree are included in PRD, roadmap, tasks, audit, and generated agent instructions.
Starter code availability is no longer represented as proof that the target runtime is already running.
Connect and Cek rencana show actionable environment advice separately from structural errors; environmental advice does not lower the plan score.
Unknown npm run script names remain structural errors unless explicitly planned in package.json by the current task or its dependencies. Web and worker share regression-tested behavior.
Worker audit reports missing dependencies, environment configuration, executables and browser runtime as warnings; actual verification and mark_done remain strict.

doctor --environment inspects prerequisites without loading or writing the ledger, running gates, installing packages, invoking Docker or migrating a database. Optional TCP diagnostics explicitly do not prove authentication or schema correctness.

setup-env explicitly copies .env.example to .env.local only when no supported existing configuration is present, the destination is ignored, and exclusive creation succeeds. It never installs dependencies or starts a DB.
Existing docker-compose.yml is referenced for optional user-approved local DB startup; npm install, migration and optional demo seeding are explained separately. No new database provider is selected.
